verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a SaaS service that processes customer transaction data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI model training, data-usage controls, or any opt-out mechanism. The llms.txt, MCP and CLI probes concern AI-facing tooling, not data-training privacy, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
